description:
Hello, I am an Aerospace engineer with a love for Prognosis and Health Management (PHM) systems. I am also a beginner at Python so our team would need programmers.

Astronauts face severe health issues in space if not adequately catered for. We don't want this since they are there to represent all of mankind, bringing us a step closer to understanding our universe through their research.

Let's build a system to help keep them healthy throughout their mission.
